detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Purchasing this DLC makes its content unlockable in the customization menu. You can unlock its associated content with requisition points obtained in PvP and PvE modes.

Rise above the concerns of flesh with the Iron Hands Chapter Pack, for the flesh is weak!

This Pack contains a unique Iron Hands Champion skin for the Techmarine class, and more than 20 cosmetics and customisation options including left and right pauldrons, chapter decals, unique gauntlets and greaves, and colour packs from 4 Iron Hands Successor Chapters:

Brazen Claws

- Left Pauldron Chapter Heraldry

- Caledor Sky Colour Pack

- Right Pauldron Raukaan marking

- Right Pauldron Kaargul marking

- Right Pauldron Armour Piece

- Left Gauntlet Armour Piece

Red Talons

- Left Pauldron Chapter Heraldry

- Right Pauldron Haarmek marking

- Right Pauldron Sorrgol marking

- Left Pauldron Armour Piece

- Left Greave Armour Piece

Sons of Medusa

- Left Pauldron Chapter Heraldry

- Moot Green Colour Pack

- Right Pauldron Borrgos marking

- Right Pauldron Morlaag marking

- Right Gauntlet Armour Piece

Iron Lords

- Left Pauldron Chapter Heraldry

- Doombull Brown Colour Pack

- Right Pauldron Vurgaan marking

- Right Pauldron Dorrvok marking

- Right Greave Armour Piece

The Iron Hands Chapter Pack is available as part of the Season Pass 2.
